headline: Anthropic Reports Third-Quarter Revenue of $17 Billion Ahead of Planned IPO
summary: AI company Anthropic reported third-quarter revenue totaling $17 billion, 12 times higher than the same period a year ago, alongside a net loss of $23 billion as it approaches an initial public offering.
why: Anthropic is a major player in the artificial intelligence sector, and its financial disclosures provide critical valuation benchmarks for private AI developers and institutional investors ahead of public listings.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Rapid revenue growth and an upcoming IPO significantly elevate the company's private market valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A dramatic twelvefold increase in quarterly revenue signals substantial commercial traction in artificial intelligence markets, attracting strong investor interest ahead of a public offering.
